agent_messages: Thinness makes morphisms proof-irrelevant: mutual arrows automatically form an isomorphism, while skeletalization turns isomorphism classes into literal equality, so functor isomorphisms become pointwise equality and the identity acts trivially on the thin skeleton. Independently, a fully faithful functor reflects isomorphisms, hence induces an injective map on skeletons.
